title: Austin Officials Announce Private Meeting
summary:
*   A special meeting was called solely to publicly announce an upcoming closed executive session.
*   Officials moved into executive session to discuss confidential matters allowed under specific state statutes.
*   No public policy decisions were made, nor were any public hearings conducted during this brief open session.
*   Any final actions or votes stemming from the closed discussions were slated to occur in a future open public meeting.
